system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature, [Harmonic Branch]

This branch of Kashu, tend to think of themselves as puppeteers, composers or even conductors of battle. This doesn’t come from Hubris, no. Instead, this comes from one of the clans core secret techniques. A special summoned creature, known as the Doki. Unlike other summoned creatures, the Doki are bound not by an elaborate contract, but instead, to the melodies you play and they are summoned the same way. Your Shinobi Instrument is their leash, and you use the music it produces to command them.

You gain access to one of three Doki’s. The Bandaged, The Claw, or the Club. You gain access to one of the remaining Doki’s at 7th and 15th levels. When initiative is rolled, you can choose to roll your initiative at disadvantage. If you do, you summon all of your Doki’s as part of rolling initiative otherwise, you can summon them one at a time as a Bonus action. They are summoned into a space that can hold them within 30 feet of you. Your Doki’s act as a bonus action on your turn, commanding all active Doki’s at once as part of the same bonus action. Your Doki’s remain until dismissed, they are reduced to 0 hit points or you are incapacitated, at which point they are dispelled. Once dismissed or defeated, a Doki cannot be resummoned until you spend at least 10 minutes meditating outside of combat.

Beginning at 11th level, you can command one Doki to at no action cost, on your turn. The remaining Doki can be commanded to move, but not use any ability, jutsu or attack it has, if commanded this way.
